scope: Splendor core game, 1st edition (2014), complete authoritative extracted/splendor-rules.txt. No expansions or later-edition additions.

questions.question: A card’s remaining cost after bonuses is one green. You hold both one green token and one gold. Must you spend green because you have it, or may you pay gold instead and keep the green? Where does the payment go?

Three gem piles contain one red, two blue and three green tokens. Other gem piles are empty. Can the three-different-gems action take one from each of these piles, or does the four-token minimum prohibit it? What would remain in those three piles?

You hold a gold token and want to exchange it directly for a red token in the supply without buying a development. Is that a listed action or a permitted use of the joker rule? What use does the summary give gold when purchasing?

On your turn you can legally buy a face-up card and can also take three different gems. You want neither benefit. May you simply pass without performing an action, or must you choose one of the four actions? This asks about voluntarily passing with legal actions available, not a state in which all actions are impossible.
